name: porter
description: Porter, an OpenID Connect provider in Lean: authorization code flow with PKCE, signed ID tokens, refresh-token rotation, compiled to WebAssembly by Lasm, with proofs

scripts.build: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerNode.lean --output dist/server
scripts.build:bun: npm run build:client && bunx --bun lasm build ServerBun.lean --target bun
scripts.build:deno: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerNode.lean --target deno
scripts.build:workers: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerWorkers.lean --target workers
scripts.build:docker: npm run build && docker build -t porter .
scripts.build:lambda: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target lambda
scripts.build:lambda-image: npm run build && docker build -f deploy/lambda-image/Dockerfile -t porter-lambda:local .
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target vercel
scripts.build:netlify: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target netlify
scripts.build:azure: npm run build && node deploy/package-hosted.mjs azure
scripts.build:gcf: npm run build && node deploy/package-hosted.mjs gcf
